text:
zoe-partners: FYI incoming from MeridianAI. They want a hosted API plus a signed-download option that uses third-party escrow and selective geo-release. Need quick alignment on gating + announcement sequencing.

ian-legal: Hosted API -> standard. Signed-download -> need redistribution addendum, escrow release triggers, and a warranty on signature provenance. Also require audit-log retention for signatures (12mo).

nina-solutions: SI needs the download bundle to include: artifact.tar.gz, manifest.json, detached signature(s), and a verification script. If they advertise edge quant, include a quant-report. We also want an example of the escrow release instruction.

zoe-partners: Partner proposes: escrow release = "addendum_signed_by_meridian_and_redwood". They can provide detached PGP + timestamped manifest. They asked if geo-only download gating (EU-only) is doable.

ian-legal: Geo gating ok but must be reflected in the addendum territory clause. Escrow release language should be explicit. Add indemnity for provenance claims.

pranav-hw: For hardware validation, we can run a quick build on our EdgeRack nodes. Need artifact URL and quant table. Note: some NIC FW versions affect mmap perf; we'll note in results.

nina-solutions: Ops suggestion: list hosted API Day 0, show a "signed-download (coming soon)" SKU with a request-to-download form gated by addendum + escrow proof. That prevents early leakage.

ops-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5120 to track Meridian signed-download gating and escrow integration  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5120

ian-legal: Action: I'll draft addendum template with redistribution clause, escrow acceptance, geo clause, signature manifest schema, and liability cap. Target: Tue.

nina-solutions: I'll prepare SI bundle template and a short verification snippet (gpg --verify, sha256sum), plus a docs stub.

zoe-partners: Commercial note: partner asked about rev-share on downloads and a small listing fee for hosted API. I'll capture commercial separately; won't block legal/tech work.

pranav-hw: Scheduling HW run for next Wed; partner to upload artifact to secure bucket by Mon.

zoe-partners: Thanks folks. Quick recap: Ian draft addendum, Nina SI bundle + docs stub, Pranav HW run next Wed, partner to upload artifacts by Mon. We'll reconvene after addendum + artifacts land.
